name: pilotv
description: PilotV monorepo root — unified local test entry. Sub-project suites: gateway (pilotdeck-mobile/upstream-official, node:test on src), UI (pilotdeck-mobile/upstream-official/ui, vitest), Python regression (scripts/). CI gates live in scripts/ci/ and are invoked by .github/workflows/ci.yml.

scripts.test: npm run test:node && npm run test:python
scripts.test:python: PYTHONPATH=. python -m unittest scripts.test_artifacts_events scripts.test_artifacts_part_paths scripts.test_artifacts_text scripts.test_gateway_lifecycle scripts.test_workspace_lite
scripts.test:full: npm test && npm run test:gateway && npm run test:ui
scripts.ci:gates: node scripts/ci/check-repo-hygiene.mjs && node scripts/ci/check-error-observability.mjs && node scripts/ci/check-script-sprawl.mjs && node scripts/ci/check-upstream-patches.mjs && bash scripts/check_deploy_script_escaping.sh scripts/deploy_pilotv_device.sh
